## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复只迁移会话的实例在重新启动后历史不完整：同时保存会话索引与历史投影，并将内部数据库目录统一到独立实例目录。
- 启动前检查本实例的会话数据库；在客户端停止时，可从匹配的本地回收副本恢复缺失的历史投影。保留已有会话与恢复前备份，不覆盖当前客户端正在写入的数据库。
- 有活动实例时，关闭管理器窗口或使用 Cmd+Q 会隐藏到托盘，实例和本地 API 连接继续运行。托盘中的“退出并停止运行实例”用于明确停止实例并退出。
- 保留 v0.4.1 的客户端版本检测、普通 / Fast、中文和 Ultra 适配，以及会话复制和可见性修复。

- Fixed incomplete history after restarting a session-only instance copy by preserving both its thread index and history projection, and normalizing internal database paths.
- Startup checks can restore missing history projections from matching local archived copies while the client is stopped. Existing history and a pre-recovery backup are preserved; live client databases are left untouched.
- Closing the manager window or pressing Cmd+Q while instances are active now hides the manager to the tray, keeping instances and local API connections running. The tray action “Exit and stop running instances” explicitly stops them.
- Retained v0.4.1 client version detection, Normal / Fast, Chinese and Ultra integration, session copying, and visibility repair.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。安装前停止实例并退出旧管理器；账号、实例与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Stop instances and quit the old manager before installing; accounts, instances and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex，Claude Code 与 Claude Desktop（Chat / Cowork / Code）仍是计划功能。客户端需单独安装；界面兼容与 Fast 的实际支持取决于客户端、模型和供应商。

Codex is currently supported. Claude Code and Claude Desktop (Chat / Cowork / Code) remain planned features. Clients must be installed separately; UI compatibility and Fast depend on the client, model and provider.

源码对应标签 [`v0.4.2`](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.4.2)，安装包校验值见附件 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

Source corresponds to tag [`v0.4.2`](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.4.2); installer checksums are in the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
